## Summary

I identified and resolved ticket T-5005. The issue was that **Prometheus' persistent volume ran out of disk space at approximately 03:00 UTC**, causing it to fail writing new metrics. The logs showed repeated "no space left on device" errors when attempting to write to the WAL and persist chunks. 

The 100Gi PVC is full, which is why dashboards had gaps and alerts didn't fire—Prometheus couldn't store any new data. Since the storage class has volume expansion enabled, the observability team can either expand the PVC to a larger size or delete old metrics to free space. Once resolved, Prometheus will resume normal operation.
